# `aitbc unstake`

Unstake tokens once the lock period ends and withdraw the principal.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc unstake [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet-name` | text | — | no | Name of the wallet to unstake into |
| `--wallet-path` | text | — | no | Direct path to wallet file (overrides --wallet-name) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL (overrides config) |
| `--stake-id` | text | — | yes | Numeric stake ID returned by 'stake'. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc unstake --stake-id <stake_id>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc unstake --stake-id <stake_id> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
